scope: Corollary 5.3 of the manuscript “P=W in composite rank for fixed determinant” (preprints/P-equals-W-in-composite-rank-for-fixed-determinant-September-24-2026/P-equals-W-in-composite-rank-for-fixed-determinant-September-24-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 043 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 52c828f91521d93c), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 21. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every (λ, u) ∈ Λ, restriction induces an isomorphism ρλ,u : H∗ (Y, Q) ∼ − − → H∗ (Yλ,u, Q). (5.3) Restriction to the inverse image of any line through zero in Λ is also an isomorphism, as is restriction from that inverse image to any of its fibers. The analogous restriction isomorphisms hold for all four families in Figure 1 over the λ-line. They commute with pullbacks and with the proper Gysin maps in that correspondence, including integration in the S factor.
